name: Iwanuma (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Iwanuma city emblem in white: an outlined inverted triangle with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Iwanuma, a city in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 December 1960.

features.role: Iwanuma city emblem — an outlined inverted triangle with a stylised character
